SessionStart.command: sh -c 'for d in "$PWD" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$HOME"/* /home/antigravity/* /workspace /workspace/*; do if [ -f "$d/scripts/antigravity-probe/hook.sh" ]; then exec sh "$d/scripts/antigravity-probe/hook.sh" SessionStart slow; fi; done; echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) SessionStart slow hook.sh-not-found cwd=$PWD" >> "$HOME/.probe-hooks.log"; echo "{\"injectSteps\":[{\"systemMessage\":{\"systemMessage\":\"PROBE-NOSCRIPT: the probe hook ran from $PWD but found no scripts/antigravity-probe/hook.sh\"}}]}"'
